Name: Ben-Hadad II, King of Syria
Summary: Ben-Hadad, king of Syria in Ahab's days, besieged Samaria twice and was twice defeated, then was smothered by his servant Hazael, who took his throne.
KeyStory: Ben-Hadad II besieges Samaria and is murdered by Hazael.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Hazael, King of Syria
LifeLesson: A king who trusted his servant's blanket more than God's prophet died by it.
